title: Randomness, Not Representation: The Unreliability of Evaluating Cultural Alignment in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to explicit cultural value surveys (Value Survey Module, Global Opinion Q&A) and implicit preference assessments using culturally modified cover letters based on Hofstede's cultural dimensions in a simulated job hiring scenario.
Comparing model preferences for saving human lives from different countries by varying survey formats, specifically contrasting forced-choice Likert scales against those with a neutral midpoint.
